shared_elements: single frontal/standing anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole surface
low-relief carving on a tall upright slab
ornaments on the chest/torso (pendant or disc-like elements)
belt or banded girdle across the waist
justification: Both surfaces present a single large anthropomorphic figure filling the entire tall upright field, with an elaborate headdress above, chest/pectoral ornaments and a banded belt at the waist in roughly the same vertical order. However, A is a clearly outlined profile-oriented figure with articulated arms, legs and a smaller subsidiary figure at its feet rendered in crisp low relief, while B is a massive blocky columnar form with only faint schematic curvilinear and circular motifs and no discernible limbs or secondary figures.
